purpose.zh: 练肩膀上方的控制，为倒立类动作做准备
purpose.en: Build control on top of your shoulders to prepare for upside-down support moves.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，把肩膀推向耳朵再放下
text.en: Keep your arms straight and push your shoulders toward your ears, then lower

text.zh: 身体成倒 V 字，手肘一直不弯。
text.en: Hold an upside-down V and keep your elbows straight the whole time.
Move slowly with a small range.

commonErrors.en: Bending the elbows into a pike push-up.

cautions.zh: 先确认倒 V 支撑不疼；手腕或肩膀不舒服时停
cautions.en: Make sure an upside-down V hold is pain-free first, and stop if your wrists or shoulders feel uncomfortable.

cautions.zh: 先做 1 组轻松的 4–6 次
cautions.en: Start with one easy set of 4–6 reps.

changes: 名字「肩带提压」是术语，改「派克位直臂耸肩 / Pike Straight-Arm Shrug」
主口令去掉「派克位」重复；口令按 0.9/0.7 s 缩短
节奏核对：动画顶点真正静止约 0.37 秒（<0.8），rep_hold 改为 rep_updown
flags: 派生把顶点算成 ≥0.8 s 判为 rep_hold，但 spec 轨道真正的静止只有约 0.4 s（注释/关键帧），若按实际应为 rep_updown，请确认
